title: Bandits with Anytime Knapsacks
abstract: arXiv:2501.18560v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider bandits with anytime knapsacks (BwAK), a novel version of the BwK problem where there is an \textit{anytime} cost constraint instead of a total cost budget. This problem setting introduces additional complexities as it mandates adherence to the constraint throughout the decision-making process. We propose SUAK (Strategic Under-utilization for Anytime Knapsacks), an algorithm that utilizes upper confidence bounds to identify the optimal mixture of arms while maintaining a balance between exploration and exploitation. SUAK is an adaptive algorithm that strategically utilizes the available budget in each round in the decision-making process and skips a round when it is possible to violate the anytime cost constraint. In particular, SUAK slightly under-utilizes the available cost budget to reduce the need for skipping rounds. We show that SUAK attains the same problem-dependent regret upper bound of $ O(K \log T)$ established

translated_title: 带任意时刻背包约束的老虎机问题
translated_abstract: 我们研究了带任意时刻背包的老虎机问题，这是背包老虎机问题的一个新变体，其中存在一个“任意时刻”的成本约束，而非总成本预算。这一问题设定带来了额外的复杂性，因为它要求在整个决策过程中始终遵守该约束。我们提出了SUAK（针对任意时刻背包的战略性低利用算法），该算法利用置信上界来识别最优的臂组合，同时在探索与利用之间保持平衡。SUAK是一种自适应算法，它在决策过程中战略性地利用每一轮的可用预算，并在可能违反任意时刻成本约束时跳过该轮。特别地，SUAK略微降低了对可用成本预算的利用，以减少跳过轮次的需求。我们证明SUAK达到了与经典问题相同的问题相关遗憾上界 $O(K \log T)$。
tldr: 本文提出了SUAK算法，用于解决带任意时刻成本约束的背包老虎机这一新问题，通过战略性地低利用预算并在必要时自适应跳过轮次，实现了与经典背包老虎机问题相同的 $O(K \log T)$ 问题相关遗憾上界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SUAK, an adaptive algorithm for the novel Bandits with Anytime Knapsacks (BwAK) problem, which strategically under-utilizes the available budget and skips rounds when necessary, achieving the same problem-dependent regret upper bound of $O(K \log T)$ as the classical BwK problem.
